exercises.title: Countable → NUMBER, uncountable → AMOUNT
exercises.instruction: Drag each noun into the correct group: "the number of" (countable, plural) or "the amount of" (uncountable).

items.explanation: "tourists" đếm được, số nhiều → the number of.
"electricity" không đếm được → the amount of.
"students" đếm được → the number of.
"waste" không đếm được → the amount of.
"cars" đếm được → the number of.
"oil" không đếm được → the amount of.
"households" đếm được → the number of.
"energy" không đếm được → the amount of.
"employees" đếm được → the number of.
"fast food" không đếm được → the amount of.
"people" là danh từ số nhiều đếm được → the number of.
"water" không đếm được → the amount of.

exercises.title: Rules for number / amount / figure / percentage

items.prompt: Điền: "The ____ of coffee exported from Vietnam reached 1.5 million tonnes."
items.explanation: coffee không đếm được → the amount of.

items.prompt: Điền: "The ____ of households owning a car doubled over the period."
items.explanation: households đếm được số nhiều → the number of.
"the figure FOR + đối tượng" — giới từ FOR, không phải OF.

items.prompt: Sau "the number of" thì danh từ phải ở dạng nào và động từ chia ra sao?

options.text: số nhiều + động từ số nhiều
số ít + động từ số ít
số nhiều + động từ số ít
số ít + động từ số nhiều

items.explanation: the number of cars WAS… — danh từ số nhiều nhưng head noun "number" số ít nên động từ số ít.

items.prompt: Với kết quả là 12%, ta dùng danh từ nào?
items.explanation: Dữ liệu phần trăm → the percentage / proportion / rate of.

exercises.title: Fill in number / amount / percentage / figure
exercises.instruction: Fill in one of: number, amount, percentage, figure.

items.prompt: The ____ of electricity consumed in Hanoi rose sharply in 2020.
items.explanation: electricity không đếm được.

items.prompt: The ____ of tourists visiting Da Nang was around 3 million.
items.explanation: tourists đếm được số nhiều.

items.prompt: The ____ of students choosing science subjects fell to 12%.
items.explanation: Kết quả là 12% → dữ liệu phần trăm.

items.prompt: The ____ for Sweden was lower than that for Norway.
items.explanation: "the figure for + tên nước".

items.prompt: The ____ of rice produced in the Mekong Delta stood at 24 million tonnes.
items.explanation: rice không đếm được.

items.prompt: The ____ of cars sold in Japan declined between 2008 and 2012.
items.explanation: cars đếm được số nhiều.

items.prompt: The ____ of waste generated by factories increased every year.
items.explanation: waste không đếm được.

items.prompt: The ____ of male teachers in the school was only 15%.
items.explanation: 15% → dữ liệu phần trăm.

exercises.title: Fix countability & agreement errors
exercises.instruction: Each sentence has exactly one mistake. Rewrite the whole sentence correctly.

items.prompt: The number of electricity consumed increased.
items.answer: The amount of electricity consumed increased.
items.explanation: electricity không đếm được → amount.

items.prompt: The amount of students studying abroad increased.
items.answer: The number of students studying abroad increased.
items.explanation: students đếm được → number.

items.prompt: The consumption fast food increased in Vietnam.
items.answer: The consumption of fast food increased in Vietnam.
items.explanation: Thiếu giới từ OF: the consumption OF fast food.

items.prompt: The number of fast food eaten increased.
items.answer: The amount of fast food eaten increased.
items.explanation: fast food không đếm được → amount.

items.prompt: The figure of Japan was higher than Korea.
items.answer: The figure for Japan was higher than that for Korea.
accept: figure for Japan was higher than that for Korea
items.explanation: "the figure FOR + nước"; so sánh số liệu với số liệu → "than that for Korea".

items.prompt: There were 30% of students chose French.
items.explanation: Không dùng "There were" với %; câu đã có động từ "chose".

exercises.title: Bare phrase → the number/amount of …
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each phrase as "the number of …" or "the amount of …" (with V-ing/V3 where needed).

sampleAnswers: the number of students studying overseas
items.promptVi: số lượng học sinh sinh viên đi du học
items.explanation: "students" đếm được → the number of + N + V-ing (studying).

sampleAnswers: the amount of electricity consumed
items.promptVi: lượng điện tiêu thụ
items.explanation: "electricity" không đếm được → the amount of + N + V3 (consumed).

sampleAnswers: the number of people using public transport
items.promptVi: số lượng người sử dụng phương tiện giao thông công cộng
items.explanation: "people" đếm được → the number of people using…

sampleAnswers: the amount of water used by households
items.promptVi: lượng nước sinh hoạt được sử dụng bởi các hộ gia đình
items.explanation: "water" không đếm được → the amount of water used by…

sampleAnswers: the number of cars sold
items.promptVi: số lượng ô tô được bán ra
items.explanation: "cars" đếm được → the number of cars sold.

sampleAnswers: the amount of oil imported
items.promptVi: lượng dầu được nhập khẩu
items.explanation: "oil" không đếm được → the amount of oil imported.

sampleAnswers: the number of households with internet access
items.promptVi: số lượng hộ gia đình có kết nối internet
items.explanation: "households" đếm được → the number of households with…

sampleAnswers: the amount of waste produced by households
items.promptVi: lượng rác thải do các hộ gia đình tạo ra
items.explanation: "waste" không đếm được → the amount of waste produced by…

exercises.title: Writing — Fast food consumption (1990)
exercises.instruction: Write 4 sentences describing the table below. You must use both "the number of" and "the amount of" correctly, and at least one sentence with "the figure for".

stimulus.caption: The amount of fast food consumed in four countries in 1990

checklist: Dùng AMOUNT (fast food không đếm được), KHÔNG dùng NUMBER
Ít nhất một câu dùng "the figure for + tên nước"
Không lặp một cấu trúc quá 2 lần
Động từ chia đúng số ít/số nhiều
rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The amount of fast food consumed in China was 10,000 tonnes, the highest of the four countries.
2. 5,000 tonnes of fast food were eaten in the US.
3. The consumption of fast food in the UK stood at 2,000 tonnes.
4. The figure for Vietnam was the lowest, at only 400 tonnes.

exercises.title: Match each strategy with an example
exercises.instruction: Match each transformation strategy with its example sentence.

items.right: the amount of electricity consumed in the UK
items.explanation: Chiến thuật 1: the amount of + N + V3 (consumed).

items.right: the consumption of electricity in the UK
items.explanation: Chiến thuật 2: the + noun + of + object (the consumption of electricity).

items.right: the amount of electricity used in the UK
items.explanation: Chiến thuật 3: đổi từ loại + dùng từ đồng nghĩa (consumed → used).

items.right: the number of people using public transport
items.explanation: Chiến thuật 1 với danh từ đếm được: the number of + N + V-ing.

items.right: the ownership of cars in Australia
items.explanation: Chiến thuật 2 với ownership: the ownership of cars.

exercises.title: Noun → V3 / V-ing
exercises.instruction: Write the participle (V3 or V-ing) that matches each noun.

items.explanation: consumption ↔ consume → consumed.
production ↔ produce → produced.
use ↔ use → used.
generation ↔ generate → generated.
ownership ↔ own → owned.
employment ↔ employ → employed.
import ↔ import → imported.
export ↔ export → exported.
investment ↔ invest → invested.
sale ↔ sell → sold (bất quy tắc).

exercises.title: Noun + of: fill in the noun
exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct noun (consumption / use / production / ownership / import).

items.explanation: "electricity consumption" → the consumption of electricity.

items.prompt: public transport use → the ____ of public transport
items.explanation: "public transport use" → the use of public transport.
"waste production" → the production of waste.
"car ownership" → the ownership of cars.
"oil imports" → the import of oil.

exercises.title: Strategy 2 — change to "the … of …"
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each "N + N" phrase as "the + noun + of + object".

sampleAnswers: the consumption of electricity
items.promptVi: lượng điện tiêu thụ
items.explanation: N + N → the + noun chính (consumption) + of + đối tượng (electricity).

sampleAnswers: the consumption of water
items.promptVi: lượng nước tiêu thụ
items.explanation: "water consumption" → the consumption of water.

sampleAnswers: the ownership of cars
items.promptVi: tỷ lệ sở hữu ô tô
items.explanation: "car ownership" → the ownership of cars (đối tượng đếm được để số nhiều).

sampleAnswers: the use of public transport
items.promptVi: mức độ sử dụng phương tiện giao thông công cộng
items.explanation: "public transport use" → the use of public transport.

sampleAnswers: the production of waste
items.promptVi: lượng rác thải sản ra
items.explanation: "waste production" → the production of waste.

sampleAnswers: the consumption of energy
items.promptVi: lượng năng lượng tiêu thụ
items.explanation: "energy consumption" → the consumption of energy.

sampleAnswers: the import of oil
oil imports
items.promptVi: lượng dầu nhập khẩu
items.explanation: "oil imports" → the import of oil.

sampleAnswers: the export of goods
goods exports
items.promptVi: lượng hàng hóa xuất khẩu
items.explanation: "goods exports" → the export of goods.

exercises.title: Strategy 3 — Word form + synonym
exercises.instruction: Change each nominalised phrase into "the amount/number of + N + V3", using a suitable synonym if it sounds more natural.

sampleAnswers: the amount of water consumed
the amount of water used
items.promptVi: lượng nước được tiêu thụ
items.explanation: consumption → consumed: the amount of water consumed.

sampleAnswers: the amount of electricity produced
the amount of electricity generated
items.promptVi: lượng điện được sản xuất
items.explanation: production → produced: the amount of electricity produced.

sampleAnswers: the amount of fast food consumed
the amount of fast food eaten
items.promptVi: lượng thức ăn nhanh được tiêu thụ
items.explanation: "fast food" không đếm được → the amount of fast food consumed.

sampleAnswers: the amount of goods imported
the amount of goods brought into the country
items.promptVi: lượng hàng hóa được nhập khẩu
items.explanation: "goods" không có số đếm cụ thể → the amount of goods imported.

sampleAnswers: the number of cars sold
items.promptVi: số lượng ô tô được bán ra
items.explanation: "cars" đếm được → the number of cars sold.

sampleAnswers: the number of houses built

items.explanation: "houses" đếm được → the number of houses built.

exercises.title: Write 3 versions of one title
exercises.instruction: Title: "Electricity consumption in the UK increased from 2000 to 2010." Write 3 versions: (1) Amount/Number + V3, (2) Noun + of, (3) Word form / synonym.

checklist: Câu 1 dùng "the amount of electricity consumed/used …"
Câu 3 đổi word form hoặc synonym hợp nghĩa (used/generated)
Giữ nguyên meaning và mốc thời gian 2000–2010
rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The amount of electricity consumed in the UK increased between 2000 and 2010.
2. The consumption of electricity in the UK rose over the same period.
3. The amount of electricity used in the UK went up from 2000 to 2010.

exercises.instruction: Paraphrase each chart title as a descriptive noun phrase, keeping the same meaning.

sampleAnswers: the amount of fast food consumed in Vietnam between 2000 and 2020
the consumption of fast food in Vietnam from 2000 to 2020

sampleAnswers: the amount of electricity consumed in four countries
the consumption of electricity in four countries
items.promptVi: lượng điện tiêu thụ ở bốn quốc gia
items.explanation: "Electricity consumption" → the amount of electricity consumed.

sampleAnswers: the number of cars owned in Australia
the number of people owning cars in Australia
items.promptVi: số lượng ô tô sở hữu ở Úc
items.explanation: "Car ownership" → the number of cars owned (cars đếm được).

sampleAnswers: the number of adults using public transport
the use of public transport among adults

sampleAnswers: the amount of water consumed by households
the consumption of water by households

the number of young people purchasing goods online

checklist: Giữ nguyên đối tượng và mốc thời gian
Dùng number cho đếm được, amount cho không đếm được

exercises.title: Mixed error correction
exercises.instruction: Each sentence has exactly one noun-phrase mistake. Rewrite the whole sentence correctly.

items.prompt: The increasing use private cars causes congestion.
items.answer: The increasing use of private cars causes congestion.
items.explanation: Thiếu OF: the increasing use OF private cars.

items.prompt: The number of waste produced by factories increased.
items.answer: The amount of waste produced by factories increased.
items.explanation: waste không đếm được → amount.

items.prompt: The amount of people owning cars rose steadily.
items.answer: The number of people owning cars rose steadily.
items.explanation: people đếm được → number.

items.prompt: The number of cars sold in Japan were falling.
items.answer: The number of cars sold in Japan was falling.
items.explanation: Head noun "number" số ít → was.

items.prompt: The consumption of electricity increased. The number of it doubled by 2010.
items.answer: The consumption of electricity increased. The figure doubled by 2010.
items.explanation: Không dùng "the number of it" — dùng "the figure" hoặc "it" để tránh lặp.

items.prompt: There was 45% of respondents preferred online classes.
items.explanation: Không dùng "There was/were" với %.

exercises.title: Order the transformation steps
exercises.instruction: Put the steps in the correct order for turning a title into a descriptive sentence.

tokens: Đưa noun phrase vào câu mô tả số liệu
answer: Đưa noun phrase vào câu mô tả số liệu
items.explanation: Head noun → word form → noun phrase → câu.
FORMULA: Determiner + Adjective + NOUN + extra information.

exercises.title: Mini writing challenge — 4 different structures
exercises.instruction: You are given a hypothetical chart about urban transport. Write 4 sentences, each using ONE different structure: (1) the number of, (2) the amount of, (3) noun + of, (4) a noun phrase with V-ing/V3.

stimulus.caption: Giao thông đô thị (số liệu giả định, năm 2020)
rows: Người đi bộ đến nơi làm

checklist: Đúng 4 câu, mỗi câu một cấu trúc khác nhau
number cho đếm được, amount cho không đếm được
Có ít nhất một participle (V-ing/V3) bổ nghĩa cho noun
Số liệu chính xác so với bảng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The number of bus users in the city was 1.2 million in 2020.
2. The amount of fuel consumed reached 800 million litres.
3. The sale of motorbikes stood at 250,000 units.
4. There were 400,000 people walking to work.

exercises.title: Introduction + descriptive sentences for a Task 1 chart
exercises.instruction: Write an Introduction (1 sentence paraphrasing the task) and 2 sentences describing the data for the task: "The chart below shows fast food consumption in Vietnam, the UK and the US between 2000 and 2020." Use at least 3 different noun-phrase structures.

checklist: Introduction chỉ 1 câu, đã paraphrase, không chép đề
Dùng AMOUNT (fast food không đếm được)
Ít nhất 3 cấu trúc noun phrase khác nhau, không lặp quá 2 lần
Không đưa quá nhiều số liệu — chọn 3–4 con số nổi bật
rubric.sampleAnswer: The line graph illustrates how much fast food was consumed in Vietnam, the UK and the US over a twenty-year period from 2000 to 2020. The amount of fast food consumed in the US was the highest throughout the period, rising to around 6,000 tonnes by 2020. The consumption of fast food in Vietnam, by contrast, remained the lowest, and the figure for the UK sat between the other two.
commonErrors: The graph shows fast food consumption… (chép đề)
